PullRequest.Title: sessions: show the Done section by default
PullRequest.Body:

`sessions.list.showArchivedByDefault` now defaults to `true`: the Agents window's sessions list shows the Done section (Archived with the archive wording) unless the user hides it with the filter menu. Reset Filters now returns the section to that default instead of hiding it, and the text that said marking a session as done hides it from the list now says that the session moves to the Done section.

Related: microsoft/vscode-internalbacklog#9782

## Change

- The setting's `default` is now `true` instead of `false`. The rest of its registration is unchanged.
- A saved filter choice still wins over the setting. Show Done (Show Archived) in the filter menu and `showArchived` in the sessions list tool store it as `sessionsListControl.excludeArchived` in profile storage.
- Reset Filters now removes that saved choice, so the list follows `sessions.list.showArchivedByDefault` again. It used to store a choice to hide the section, which would have hidden it despite the new default. Undo still restores the previous choice.
- The Mark as Done suggestion's overview, and the matching sentence in the Agents window and chat accessibility help, now say that marking a session as done (archiving it) moves it to the "Done" ("Archived") section of the sessions list instead of hiding it from the list. The accessibility help for marking a single nested chat as done now says that the chat gets its own row in that section, and that Done only needs to be enabled in the Filter menu when the section is hidden.
- `SessionsList.excludesArchivedByDefault()` still treats an unset value as hidden. The setting is registered wherever the Sessions view is, so that fallback only applies in unit tests, whose `TestConfigurationService` returns `undefined` for unset settings.
- Tests: the registration test pins `default: true`, the Reset Filters tests expect the reset to follow the setting without storing a choice, and the suggestion and accessibility help tests expect the new wording.

## How to test

1. Run this branch from sources and open the Agents window from a profile without a saved `sessionsListControl.excludeArchived`: either a fresh `--user-data-dir`, or your profile after running **Reset Filters** in the sessions filter menu, which on this branch clears the saved choice. Leave `sessions.list.showArchivedByDefault` out of your user settings.
2. Mark a session as done. It moves to the Done section at the end of the sessions list, which starts collapsed, and **Show Done** is checked in the filter menu. Before this change, the section stayed hidden until you checked Show Done.
3. Uncheck **Show Done**: the section hides, and stays hidden after a reload.
4. Run **Reset Filters**: the Done section shows again. Before this change, Reset Filters hid it. **Undo** in the notice hides it again.
5. Set `sessions.list.showArchivedByDefault` to `false` and run **Reset Filters**: the Done section is hidden.

## Validation

- `pnpm run typecheck-client` (`tsc --project ./src/tsconfig.json --noEmit --skipLibCheck`): passed.
- `pnpm run eslint` on the 9 changed files: passed.
- `pnpm run build-fast --client-only`: passed.
- `./scripts/test.sh --reporter dot --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/test/browser/sessions.contribution.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/widget/input/chatSessionArchiveNudge.test.ts --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/accessibility/chatAccessibilityHelp.test.ts --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/chat/test/browser/sessionsChatAccessibilityHelp.test.ts --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/test/browser/sessionsList.test.ts --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/test/browser/sessionsListTools.test.ts --run src/vs/sessions/contrib/sessions/test/browser/sessionsViewMenu.test.ts`: 708 passing.
- An earlier run of the first five of those files, before the Reset Filters change, had one failure: `SessionsList inline feedback actions observes only enabled visible rows and targets one peer under multiselection (date)`. It measures a row's height after a timeout and doesn't read this setting. It passed when run alone (`--grep "observes only enabled visible rows"`: 3 passing), in a full re-run of `sessionsList.test.ts` (481 passing), and in the final run above.
- Pre-commit hygiene hook (`node --experimental-strip-types build/hygiene.ts`): passed.
- Not run: manual testing in a running Agents window, and the component fixture screenshots. The suggestion's fixtures will render the new overview text; none of them block CI.

Findings.ConfidenceRationale: The default-to-filter call path, unconditional child allocation before collapse, and repeated visible-update triggers are explicit in the code. Exact history sizes and milliseconds vary by user, but the linear hidden-work mechanism and fresh-profile reachability are deterministic.
Findings.PerformanceResource: CPU work and allocated/retained tree element objects, including one session node plus nested chat nodes per archived entry on each rebuild.
Findings.PerformanceScaling: Cost grows linearly with the effective number of locally cached or previously discovered archived sessions and their listed chats, and is paid again on each visible list update; archive history naturally grows over the profile lifetime.
Findings.PerformanceOutcome: Increased Agents-view render/update latency and CPU/GC pressure as archived history grows.
Findings.PreviousBehavior: With the previous false default, `SessionsList.update()` removed archived sessions at its early `_excludeArchived` filter and did not construct an archived section or its child tree nodes unless the user explicitly enabled Done.
Findings.ChangedBehavior: Changing the default to true makes `_excludeArchived` false for every fresh profile, so archived sessions now flow through every visible SessionsList rebuild even though the Done section is created collapsed by default.
Findings.CausalDiffEvidence: The added `default: true` line flips fresh profiles from excluding archived sessions to including them, activating the unchanged eager subtree-construction path on initial render and every list update.
Findings.Title: Lazily build the default-collapsed Done subtree
Findings.Impact: Opening the Agents view and ordinary session/status/model updates can become progressively slower and produce UI-thread/GC pressure for users with a long Done history, despite the Done section remaining collapsed and no archived row being visible.
Findings.Evidence: The constructor derives `_excludeArchived` from this setting (`sessionsList.ts:4821`). When false, `update()` keeps archived entries, sorts all filtered sessions in `groupSessionsForList` (`sessionsList.ts:5902`, `sessionsList.ts:9900`), and `renderSection` unconditionally calls `renderSessionChildren`/`toSessionChildren` for every archived session and nested chat before assigning `PreserveOrCollapsed` (`sessionsList.ts:6155-6234`). The resulting full child array is passed to `tree.setChildren` (`sessionsList.ts:6465-6484`). Session/model/provider changes invoke `refresh()` or `update()` while the view is visible (`sessionsList.ts:5639-5673`). The existing archive-demand guard only postpones remote discovery until expansion (`sessionsList.ts:6970-6978`); it does not prevent this synchronous construction for locally cached or already-discovered archives.
Findings.Recommendation: Keep the Done header visible by default, but do not build its session/chat children while it is collapsed. Populate the subtree on expansion (and for active search), and clear or cap it again on collapse while preserving the existing remote archive-demand lifecycle.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open the Agents/Sessions view in a fresh profile with an accumulated local or previously discovered Done history
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The visible view constructor synchronously refreshes the session catalog, filters/groups/sorts it, constructs tree elements, and calls `tree.setChildren` before the list render is usable. The remote archive inventory is off this path because the Done section starts collapsed.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Effective cardinality is every listed archived session already present in provider caches plus each listed nested archived chat; the section-level workspace cap does not apply to the Done section.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The rebuild runs synchronously on the UI thread. Some update sources are coalesced to the next animation frame, but concrete session deltas and model changes call refresh/update synchronously; there is no limiter because this is in-process collection work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold remote archive data is not requested while collapsed. Local provider caches and any warm remote archive cache are synchronously enumerated; once remote archives have been discovered, they remain part of subsequent rebuilds.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the changed default deterministically disables the early archive filter, and the code unconditionally allocates archived child nodes before applying the collapsed state.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The exact archive count and per-update duration vary by profile, but Done history grows over time and the full hidden subtree is rebuilt regardless of visibility.
Scenarios.Verdict: Reportable medium-severity regression: the new default eagerly rebuilds an invisible, history-scaled subtree on initial render and repeated list updates.

Scenarios.Scenario: Expand the default-visible Done section to browse archived sessions
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Expansion updates archive demand; if remote inventory is cold, authentication/feed startup and `listSessions({ includeArchived: true })` must finish before remote archived rows appear. Existing local rows remain available immediately.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Discover archived cloud sessions through `listSessions` with `includeArchived`
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One coalesced full-inventory request on a cold expansion, with a bounded retry for failed task IDs; not one request per archived session.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Before the diff, users first enabled Show Done and then expanded the same section; explicit expansion used the same demand and network path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: On cold expansion it gates appearance of remote archived rows, but it is not on initial view rendering because the section is collapsed.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One full archive-discovery request per provider demand transition, returning the provider's archived inventory; results are reconciled into the cached session collection.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Archive demand is reference-counted across consumers. Provider discovery coalesces in-flight work and performs one full inventory call rather than per-session network fan-out.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Cold or errored state triggers discovery. Warm `_archivesLoaded` state avoids another full request, and collapsing releases demand without discarding loaded results.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High that the boundary is unchanged and remains demand-gated.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Provider inventory size and network duration vary, but call placement and coalescing are explicit.
Scenarios.Verdict: No additional finding: the diff makes the header visible but does not expand it or newly trigger remote discovery.

Scenarios.Scenario: Reset Sessions filters after the setting default changes
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Reset synchronously removes the saved archive-filter override, recomputes `_excludeArchived` from configuration, and rebuilds the visible list; the same archived grouping/tree construction must finish before reset UI settles.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One profile-storage removal per reset, replacing the prior single storage write.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Reset previously stored one explicit `true` value; it now removes the key so the configuration default applies.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: A constant-count storage mutation occurs during reset; it is not the scaling cost behind the finding.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: The rebuild scales with all cached archived sessions and archived nested chats after effective provider/session filtering.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Reset is a single synchronous UI action; list work is not parallelized. Undo performs another synchronous rebuild of the captured state.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Reset does not fetch cold remote archives because the Done section stays collapsed, but it immediately includes all warm/local archived entries. Storage state changes from an explicit boolean to no override.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High for the synchronous reset path and archive-scaled rebuild; low relevance of the constant storage-operation change.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Storage implementation latency is not established and call count is unchanged in order, so it is not independently reportable.
Scenarios.Verdict: Covered by the same eager hidden-subtree finding; no separate boundary or concurrency issue.

Scenarios.Scenario: Render archive nudge and accessibility-help wording
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Localized strings are built only when the nudge/help surface is rendered and assigned to existing text content; this is small synchronous UI work.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Constant text size and one assignment per shown surface; no collection multiplicity.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single synchronous render with no queue, parallel work, or fan-out.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Localization lookup behavior is unchanged; only literal text and one already-computed section-label interpolation changed.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material; the added string length is negligible.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all nine changed files. One diff-caused eager-rendering regression was submitted: the new default includes the full archived history in every SessionsList rebuild even while the Done section is collapsed. Remote archive discovery remains correctly demand-gated and coalesced; text-only changes and the reset storage mutation add no separate reportable performance issue.
